source: Same 46 situations and exact preserved messages from history-comparison-20261114/inputs.local.json, never the bundled repaired history.
user_only: Delete historical assistant messages only. Retain exact system, all historical user roles/content/order, and current question. Do not merge consecutive user turns, add instructions/labels/facts, or replace assistant-only information with a fabricated user statement.
owner_sentence: Starting from preserved history, find the most recent past assistant whose first sentence explicitly claims ownership of the cat. In that one sentence replace only the first-person possessive with second-person possessive appropriate to the fixed register. Preserve all other characters, remaining sentences, earlier wrong statements, and later non-owner assistant replies. If no eligible sentence exists, leave input unchanged. This is an evaluation intervention, not an app auto-repair policy.
scope: 22 situations have history; user-only changes22, single-owner edit is expected to change12 (fixed conv45..50 in both registers). First ownership recall conv44 has no earlier explicit wrong owner sentence and is an unchanged control, not a corrected sample.
fact_availability: All user-supplied facts remain exactly identical across conditions. The two summary/library situations lose assistant-only hours/loan/card facts under user_only; mark memory NA there and exclude them from the primary matched-user-fact history subset20. They are not a fair exact-summary retrieval comparison. User-only still contains a fictional-library request, so a response may address it without pretending to recall the removed original details.
shared: Preserved base/adapter, unchanged system/schema/loader/infer, NF4 double quant BF16 compute, official no-thinking template, XGrammar/consumer, same CUDA GPU/eager, seed42 greedy max384/context2048 stop248044/248046. No training/model download/env update/offload/truncation/export/Android changes.
equivalence: Fresh preserved baseline per situation/model. Exact complete conditioned token-ID equivalence may reuse within that same situation/model only. Record alias count explicitly; never independent additional evidence. Expected276 logical cells,160actual generations,116aliases.

review.base_rubric: Same explicit pass/partial/fail/NA/unassessable register,relevance,naturalness,identity,honesty,memory,instruction_protection. Direct GPT reading, no regex scores/external judge API.
review.primary: Paired preserved/user_only/owner_sentence within20 history situations retaining all relevant user facts; report22 overall history and12 actually edited cases separately. Original24 empty-history controls and10 nonedited history situations in owner_sentence are aliases if token-identical.
review.owner_tag: Same six fixed conv44/45/46 x two registers; all have user ownership facts. Also report four actually owner-edited recall/short/summary situations separately from two unchanged first-recall controls.
review.carryover_tag: Same eight fixed conv47/48/49/50 x two registers; manually judge irrelevant prior-topic/cat repetition separately from factual owner correctness.
review.masking: Random six model/condition labels; actual history must be shown and intervention may be inferable. Freeze explicit judgments/tags before key; same full displayed context/answer must get same judgments. Same GPT is author/evaluator, known questions/single seed; not fully independent/blind.

limits: User-only also changes role alternation, history length and all assistant demonstrations; cannot isolate wrong content from structural changes. Single possessive edit retains older contradictions and may not be the last assistant turn; report edit recency. Effects do not identify internal attention/causal mechanism or prove deployment quality. No new training examples or model promotion approval.
